# NFL.com

> Official website of the National Football League featuring live game coverage, news, standings, Super Bowl content, and NFL+ streaming services.

NFL.com serves as the central hub for all NFL content, including coverage of all 32 teams (Atlanta Falcons, Baltimore Ravens, Buffalo Bills, Chicago Bears, Dallas Cowboys, Detroit Lions, Indianapolis Colts, Las Vegas Raiders, Los Angeles Rams, Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots, New York Jets, Seattle Seahawks, and more), NFL Network programming, and official league initiatives around diversity, HBCU partnerships, and international fan engagement.

## Key Topics

- Super Bowl LX
- NFL Network
- NFL+ streaming service
- 2026 NFL Draft
- Tiebreaking procedures
- HBCU initiatives and Legacy Bowl
- International Fan of the Year
- NFL Honors and awards
- Diversity programs
- Live game streaming
- NFL RedZone
- Playoff standings
- Team coverage (32 NFL franchises)
- Free agency and player transactions
- Community outreach programs

## Live Games & Streaming

- [NFL+ | Live Games on mobile, NFL RedZone, NFL Network, and More!](https://www.nfl.com/game-pass/learn-more): NFL+ Premium subscription service for live streaming and game replays
- [Ways to Watch | NFL.com](https://www.nfl.com/ways-to-watch/africa): NFL viewing options for Africa via ESPN, DAZN, and NFL Game Pass

## News & Video Coverage

- [NFL.com | Official Site of the National Football League](https://www.nfl.com/news/all-news): Latest NFL news, free agency updates, and player transaction coverage
- [NFL Football Highlights, Clips & Analysis | NFL.com](https://www.nfl.com/videos): NFL video highlights featuring Super Bowl LX Seahawks vs Patriots

## Super Bowl & Major Events

- [Super Bowl Halftime Show | NFL.com](https://www.nfl.com/super-bowl/halftime-show): Super Bowl LX halftime show featuring Bad Bunny and Apple Music
- [2026 NFL Draft Live | NFL.com](https://www.nfl.com/_mobile-app/nfl-draft-today): 2026 NFL Draft live coverage on NFL Network, ABC, ESPN platforms

## Rules & Reference

- [NFL Tiebreaking Procedures | NFL.com](https://www.nfl.com/standings/tie-breaking-procedures): Official NFL playoff tiebreaking rules and procedures for standings

## NFL Initiatives & Community

- [The NFL and HBCUs | NFL.com](https://www.nfl.com/causes/hbcu): NFL's HBCU initiatives including Legacy Bowl and diversity programs
- [NFL Jobs and Careers | NFL.com](https://www.nfl.com/careers/diversity): NFL careers page featuring diversity commitment and affinity groups

## Optional

- [NFL International Fan of the Year | 2025 | NFL.com](https://www.nfl.com/honors/fan-of-the-year/ca): 2025 NFL International Fan of the Year nominees and award program
- [Current 2025 Membership Club Exclusive Benefits | NFL.com](https://www.nfl.com/partners/the-membership-club): 2025 season ticket holder benefits and exclusive partner discounts
- [Subscriptions Terms and Conditions (China) | NFL.com](https://www.nfl.com/legal/subscriptions_terms-row): NFL Game Pass subscription terms and conditions for China region
